ACTION 03 OF 32 · PHASE 01

Tell the whole business story

Turn fragments of an idea into a usable, non-fiction starting brief.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter creating the Project and instructions.ESTIMATED WORK TIME20 min
↗
Your one job

Turn fragments of an idea into a usable, non-fiction starting brief.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Record why this problem matters, when it happens and what your proposed solution changes.

  2. 02

    Explain how the customer discovers, buys, receives and repeats the service/product.

  3. 03

    Add constraints: staffing, suppliers, island geography, payment methods, permits, personal time and cash.

  4. 04

    Have ChatGPT summarize the result into a one-page brief. Edit it yourself before using it for other work.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Use only my notes below to write my Business Source of Truth with headings: Customer, Problem, Current Alternatives, Offer, How We Earn, Delivery Process, Geography, Constraints, Evidence, Unknowns, 90-Day Goal. Mark every assumption [UNVERIFIED]. Do not fill missing sections with fiction. Notes: [PASTE MY STORY]. Then ask me for the five most consequential missing details.
03

Finish with this

A founder-approved source-of-truth document to reuse in every following step.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • The customer and problem can be explained in 30 seconds
  • There are no invented claims in the brief
  • Major constraints and unknowns are visible
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Don't let a polished AI summary erase uncertainty or make the idea sound validated.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A person unfamiliar with the idea can read the brief and understand the problem, buyer, offer, constraints and what's still unknown.
